When a service's cloud cost jumps, the team investigates it.

The team reviews cloud spend in the first team meeting of each month, against the baseline in FCT-0001. Any service whose monthly cost rises by more than 20% is investigated by its owner before the next review. [DEC-0002]

## Details

- The owner of the review is the data platform lead, as stated in ROL-0001.
- The team uses the finance cost export for the previous month as input for the review.
- The output of the review is one line per investigated service in the meeting notes.

## Evidence

- Agreed at the 3 February 2026 team meeting; the 20% threshold is stated in the notes. [DEC-0002]
- The data platform lead owns the warehouse, the refresh schedule, access to the reporting workspace and the monthly cost review, as stated in ROL-0001.

Sources:
- DEC-0002: Team meeting notes, 3 February 2026 - https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/harbour-data/Shared%20Documents/Minutes/2026-02-03%20Team%20meeting.docx
- ROL-0001: Team roles page, June 2026

Current: review overdue (DEC-0002's Review by date is 2027-02-05)

Note: The team knowledge base does not cover the specific service or the exact circumstances of the cost jump, so the answer is based on the general process outlined in DEC-0002.
